messages.content: Read the supplied record. Answer only the question in the current turn using the required JSON format.

DC network with + at 12 V and 0 at 0 V. Switch order is s,t,u (1 means closed). A bracketed resistor conducts only when its switch is closed. Each resistor lists its oriented start and end nodes and its resistance in ohms. R1=+>a:5 R2=a>d:2 R3=b>d:5 R4=f>b:5 R5=e>f:5 R6=e>c:7 R7=c>0:5 R8=e>b:5 R9=0>b:2 R10=0>e:9 R11=a>b:9 R12=a>c:8 R13=+>e:6 R14=0>d:9 R15=d>f:4[s] R16=c>+:3[t] R17=e>d:2[u].
The target label is Y if the signed current of R6 > 0 A, and N otherwise.
Initial comparator: signed current of R17 > 0 A
Other comparators: M41: signed current of R15 > 0 A | M52: signed current of R4 > 164845866/734431451 A
H means a comparator condition holds and L means it fails. All currents are exact amperes.
ID stu target_current initial M41 M52 target_label
CM 110 -178740108/817988743 L H H N
IM 010 -31493928/140257213 L L H N

Observed readings: initial = L; M52 = H.
The table shows exactly the two survivors compatible with the observed readings.
Report the target label for each survivor. Return only a JSON object with keys CM and IM, each having value Y or N.
Is the target label Y for at least one of the two survivors? Return only the JSON field answer, using Y for yes and N for no.
